barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Trains your foot soldiers: spearmen, skirmishers and archers. Weapon research is done here.

farm.name: Farm
farm.desc: A field of food that workers tend without walking far. When it's worked out it lies fallow; reseed it for wood.
farm.note: when built, its ground becomes crops (a rice paddy in water, for amphibians): one farm, one pool of food; worked out it lies fallow, and a worker can reseed it for wood

house.name: House
house.desc: Room for more of your people. Every unit needs space; without houses, training stops.

stable.name: Stable
stable.desc: Trains your large unit: a rider, a giant or a heavy, whatever your race fields.
stable.note: the large unit (mounts, giants or heavies)

town_center.name: Town Center
town_center.desc: The heart of your town: trains workers, takes in every resource, and is where you age up. Lose it and you lose.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.desc: A lookout that shoots the nearest enemy in range and sees far into the fog.
watchtower.note: shoots the nearest enemy in range
